overviewHtml:
"Is this service healthy?" is asked often and answered differently each time. This prompt makes the check repeatable, so every review covers the same signals and ends with a clear verdict.

What you get

  • Current response time, errors and throughput
  • Active problems and alerts
  • Recent deployments and their impact
  • The five slowest endpoints and any security vulnerabilities
getStartedHtml:
You need a Dynatrace environment, the Dynatrace for AI skills and a tool that reaches it (dtctl or the Dynatrace MCP server).

  1. Copy the prompt into your AI chat or prompt folder
  2. Name the service, or let it infer it from your workspace
  3. Review the summary and follow up on flagged issues
